app.title: YouTube Downloader
header.title: YouTube Downloader
field.url.placeholder: Paste one YouTube URL per line, then click Add…
dialog.cookie_file.title: Choose cookies.txt
queue.empty: No downloads queued. Paste URLs above and click Add.
log.ready: Ready. Paste URLs and click Add.
log.no_ffmpeg: Warning: ffmpeg not found on PATH. Audio (mp3) extraction and high-quality video merging will fail.
log.no_ffmpeg.install: Install: winget install Gyan.FFmpeg (Windows) / sudo pacman -S ffmpeg (Arch) / brew install ffmpeg (macOS)
msg.no_url.title: No URLs
msg.no_url.body: Paste at least one YouTube URL first.
msg.bad_folder.title: Output folder
banner.ffmpeg_missing: ffmpeg is not installed. Audio extraction and high-quality video merging will fail.
banner.update_available: An update is available ({n} new commit(s) on origin/main).
banner.no_git_checkout: Auto-update is disabled — this folder isn't a git checkout. Connect to GitHub to enable updates? (Local file edits will be overwritten.)
banner.bot_detection: YouTube is rate-limiting this IP ("Sign in to confirm you're not a bot"). Pick your browser under "Browser cookies" below to send your YouTube session and bypass the check.
banner.chromium_cookies: Chromium browser cookies can fail on Windows because Chrome/Edge/Brave use App-Bound Encryption (DPAPI). Use Firefox cookies or export YouTube cookies to cookies.txt.
banner.anyip_not_configured: YouTube rate-limiting was detected, but anyIP rescue is missing username or password.
banner.js_runtime_missing: A JavaScript runtime is required to fetch video formats from YouTube (anti-bot challenge solver). Install Deno?
banner.no_pm: ffmpeg is not installed and no supported package manager was found on this system. Install it manually and restart the app.
banner.manual_install: Run this command yourself to install:
log.update_done: Updated. Restart the app to use the new version.
log.auto_update_enabling: Connecting this folder to GitHub origin/main…
log.auto_update_enabled: Auto-update enabled. Files synced to latest origin/main.
log.auto_cookies_switched: Bot-check fired — switching to {browser} cookies and retrying.
log.auto_cookies_no_browser: Bot-check fired but no usable browser was detected for cookies. Pick one under "Browser cookies" manually.
log.anyip_activated: YouTube rate-limit persisted — activating anyIP proxy rescue and retrying.
msg.restart.title: Restart required
msg.restart.body: The app has been updated. Restart now to use the new version?
error.backend: The app's backend did not respond: {error}
msg.close.title: Downloads in progress
msg.close.body: {n} download(s) still running. Quit now? They will continue from where they stopped the next time you open the app.
msg.close.body_stop: {n} download(s) still running. Quit now? They will be stopped.
msg.error.title: Something went wrong
banner.app_update: Version {version} of the app is available.
banner.ytdlp_missing: yt-dlp is not available, so downloads cannot start. Download it now?
settings.title: Settings
hint.video_only: Container and re-encoding apply to video downloads only.
hint.anyip: Used only when YouTube keeps rate-limiting after cookies were tried.
hint.password_set: A password is saved. Type a new one to replace it.
check.restore_queue: Keep the queue across restarts (unfinished downloads resume)
update.ready: Version {version} is installed. Restart to use it.
